lessons: A 231-pixel label leak can split a single leaf into two technical objects, despite identical RGB and perfect source coverage.
Reassigning by actual leaf instance repaired the semantic identity and removed one object, but did not reduce cuts: object count alone is not a quality metric.
Do not merge nearby independent lily pads just because they share RGB or touch.
A source-less OSP cannot produce a valid native fidelity report; record the refusal, not a synthetic score.
next_action: Audit remaining lily/reed boundaries with same-RGB connected components and visual confirmation; prioritize reconstruction of continuous reed stems without bridging different leaves, then test true CLI OSP variants and request independent review. Fix source-embedding/fidelity workflow before using that metric.
